name: What is the process for repairing damaged eaves?
description: Eaves repair involves inspecting damage, removing affected sections, installing new materials, and finishing, with site protection and cleanup throughout.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for repairing damaged eaves?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for repairing damaged eaves typically involves a thorough inspection to assess the extent and cause of the damage, often including checking for underlying issues like roof leaks. Following the assessment, damaged sections of fascia, soffit, or sub-fascia are carefully removed. New materials are then cut, fitted, and secured, often followed by painting or sealing to match the existing exterior. Before any work begins, we ensure the area below is protected, and after completion, all debris is removed, leaving the site clean.
acceptedAnswer.description: Eaves repair involves inspecting damage, removing affected sections, installing new materials, and finishing, with site protection and cleanup throughout.
